mechanism: Infliximab increases infection risk via immunosuppression while mefloquine has neurotoxic potential; combined use may impair immune response to malaria treatment and increase CNS adverse effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if malaria prophylaxis is essential, consider alternative antimalarials (atovaquone-proguanil or doxycycline) and monitor closely for neuropsychiatric and infectious complications.
